normalized_text: The Mission Transcript Collection includes scanned transcripts from recorded air-to-ground transmissions and onboard astronaut recordings. The collection contains 80 transcripts and approximately 45,000 pages of text. Most Apollo missions produced several transcript types, including onboard and air-to-ground technical transcripts.
